title: 第10章 李家参天树
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
祖祖年龄大了。

    耳背。

    李西海与李西朋大声喊了两声，祖祖才听清楚。

    “七娃子，幺娃子。”

    祖祖拉着两个重孙子的手，很是高兴，“吃了没有？”

    “吃了。”

    “在外面怎么样了啊？”

    祖祖的声音很是洪亮，身体也很康健，能走能吃，只是耳背而已。

    家里给他配了助听器的，只是祖祖平时不喜欢戴。

    “好就行，好就行。”

    陪祖祖说了一会儿话，李西海就自觉去田里了。

    回来不干活不行的。

    两人脱下鞋子，挽起裤腿，就下田了。

    “爷！”

    李西海自然是到自家爷爷这边来。

    “听你爸说，大城市混不下去，回来养伤了？”

    爷爷年龄虽然七十有三，但下地干活，没有半点压力，身体素质比李大兴这些长期坐办公室，作息不正常的都要好。

    “不是爷。”

    “怎么谁都是这么说啊。”

    李西海无语道：“刚才大爷也是这样。”

    “你少提你大爷，他就从小到大就偷奸耍滑，这老了老了，还是那德性。”

    李胜利道：“要不是我们拉扯，你祖祖差点就抽他了。”

    李西海一个哆嗦。

    祖祖真会抽人的。

    当然不会对他们这些小辈，都不用祖祖动手，他的孙子就会代劳。

    更多是还是爷爷这一辈。

    当着小辈的面，那是说抽就抽的，一点情面都不留。

    爷爷这话不假，不是拉着的话，大爷肯定挨收拾。

    “去，跟你哥打个招呼。”

    “谁？”

    “你堂伯李大国的儿子，李西安。”

    “嗯？”

    李西海惊讶道：“我听说他成了领导的大秘，怎么有时间回来啊？”

    爷爷一边插秧，一边说道：“我也是听你二大爷说的。”

    “新来的县委书记，是你三大伯的人，先前是在市委党校常务副校长，正好咱们县的老书记调走，你三大伯发力，把他给调出来了。”

    我了个去。

    从条到面。

    从党校到主政一县。

    李西海怎么可能不明白其中的阻力。

    跨越的难度可不是一般的大啊。

    三大伯李大功，是二大爷家的，李家最优秀杰出的三代，是三代唯一的大学生，顶尖学府毕业出来的。

    多年仕途奋斗，现在是林江市的副市长，进常委了的。

    名副其实的李家参天树。

    凡是在体制内的，谁不是受到过三大伯的影响。
content_en:
Zuzu is getting older.

    Deafness.

    Li Xihai and Li Xipeng shouted twice before Zuzu heard clearly.

    "Qiwazi, Yaowazi."

    Zuzu held the hands of his two great-grandsons and was very happy, "Have you eaten?"

    "Eat."

    "How's it going outside?"

    Zuzu’s voice is very loud and he is in good health. He can walk and eat, but he is just deaf.

    He was equipped with a hearing aid at home, but Zuzu didn't like to wear it.

    "That's fine, that's fine."

    After chatting with Zuzu for a while, Li Xihai went to the fields on his own initiative.

    It’s impossible not to work when you come back.

    The two took off their shoes, rolled up their trouser legs, and went to the fields.

    "Master!"

    Li Xihai naturally came to his grandfather's side.

    "I heard from your dad that you can't survive in a big city. Are you coming back to recuperate?"

    Although grandpa is in his seventies, he works in the fields without any pressure. His physical condition is better than that of Li Daxing, who sits in an office for a long time and has an abnormal schedule.

    "It's not me."

    "Why is everyone saying that?"

    Li Xihai said speechlessly: "The uncle was like this just now."

    "Don't talk about your uncle. He has been cheating and cheating since he was a child. Even when he gets older, he still has the same virtue."

    Li Shengli said: "If we hadn't pulled him, your ancestor would have almost whipped him."

    Li Xihai trembled.

    Zuzu is really good at beating people up.

    Of course, we won't do anything to these juniors. Zuzu doesn't need to do anything, his grandson will do it for him.

    Most of them are from my grandfather’s generation.

    In front of the juniors, he slapped him on the spur of the moment, without any mercy.

    Grandpa's words are true. If he hadn't pulled me away, he would have been punished.

    "Go and say hello to your brother."

    "Who?"

    "Your cousin Li Daguo's son, Li Xi'an."

    "Huh?"

    Li Xihai said in surprise: "I heard that he became the leader's secret secretary. How come he has time to come back?"

    While planting the rice seedlings, grandpa said, "I also heard what your second uncle said."

    "The new county party secretary is your third uncle's son. He was previously the executive vice president of the Municipal Party School. It happened that our county's old secretary was transferred. Your third uncle worked hard and transferred him out."

    I'll go.

    From strips to noodles.

    From the party school to taking charge of a county.

    How could Li Xihai not understand the resistance involved.

    The difficulty of crossing is not ordinary.

    The third uncle, Li Dagong, is from the second uncle's family. He is the most outstanding and outstanding third generation of the Li family. He is the only college student of the third generation who graduated from a top university.

    After years of hard work in officialdom, he is now the deputy mayor of Linjiang City and has joined the Standing Committee.

    A veritable towering tree of the Li family.

    Everyone within the system has been influenced by the third uncle.
title_en: Chapter 10 The Li Family Towering Tree
